pre_ipo_investors: Suzhou Yongyu Equity Investment Partnership (fund manager: Hainan Shiyu Private Equity Management Co., Ltd.) - 17,327,000 shares (5.78% before A-share IPO, 4.34% after) in the 2019-March 2020 pre-IPO financing; other pre-IPO investors include Shenzhen Fuhai Stock Toubang No.7, Haitong Innovation Capital, Xiamen Hengyao, Shanghai Xuchao, Anhui Hezhuang, Ganzhou Development No.1, Wuhu Xinde No.1, Zhuhai Huajin Fengying No.2, Shenzhen Zhongkai Fusheng, etc. (one round, RMB1,973.742m, Dec 2019 / March 2020)
board_roster_reviewed: Ten directors at listing: Tang Chunshan (ED, founder/controller), Liu Datao (Chairman, ED, GM), Wu Hai (ED), Hu Huiguo (ED), Gui Xun (ED, employee rep) - management, no investor link; Wu Yufeng (NED, appointed Dec 2024) - managing partner of Hainan Shiyu Private Equity Management Co., Ltd., which is the fund manager of pre-IPO investor Suzhou Yongyu -> LINKED; Qin Zhengyu, Xu Qing, Zhao Qian, Wang Fang (INEDs) - accountant/physician/academic/IT, no investor link. Former NED Guo Yongqi (June 2020 - Dec 2024, resigned) and former director Xie Ning are not on the board at listing; no investor link stated for them.
rights_and_timing: Seat: Wu Yufeng (NED) sits on the board at listing and is managing partner of Shiyu, the fund manager of pre-IPO investor Suzhou Yongyu (pre-IPO round Dec 2019/Mar 2020, later 4.34% post A-share IPO). The prospectus does not say he was 'nominated by' Yongyu, and does not disclose whether Yongyu still holds shares at the Latest Practicable Date (Yongyu is absent from the LPD-period disclosures), so the link is via a partner of the investor's manager. No special-rights/nomination/observer right section for pre-IPO investors was found; waiver text states existing minority (permitted) shareholders have no power to appoint directors or other special rights. Confidence moderate: the link rests on the fund-manager relationship, not an explicit nomination statement.
